title: AventiqLab Shared Vocabulary
description: Controlled vocabularies referenced by every other schema in this repository. Change values here, not in individual schemas, so terminology stays consistent across learner profiles, capabilities, experiences, and skill evaluators.

capability_verb.description: The 8 non-synonymous capability verbs. KNOW = recall facts/terminology. UNDERSTAND = reason about why/tradeoffs conceptually without having built/operated it. BUILD = construct/implement/configure from requirements. OPERATE = run/monitor/maintain a live system ongoing. DESIGN = make cross-constraint architecture tradeoff decisions. TROUBLESHOOT = diagnose root cause from symptoms under uncertainty. EXPLAIN = externally communicate reasoning/decisions to others. PROVE = produce verifiable evidence substantiating a claim.

progression_archetype.description: The dominant verb-stage an experience develops. See /experience-model/experience-progression.md.

domain_slug.description: The 21 capability domains. See /capability-map/domain-index.yaml for authored-vs-stub status.
